not_annotated_note: not_annotated means a matching UniProt record was retrieved and carries no signal-peptide annotation. It is NOT a confirmed biological negative and is never pooled with unverifiable or treated as absence.
interpretation_limits: Annotation agreement is descriptive co-occurrence. It is not causal evidence and does not show that a feature encodes localisation or a signal peptide.
Untyped InterPro entries are not treated as families anywhere in this report.
No significance claim is made; the ranking screened thousands of features without multiplicity control.

signal_interval_scope.rule: signal-peptide features with EXACT start and end whose coordinates are verified to apply to the frozen extraction-input sequence, in the annotation-conditioned discovery sample
signal_interval_scope.comparison: mean activation over residues [start, end] versus over all other visible residues
